blurb: Guests rent Jet Skis or pontoon boats to cruise the St. Johns River and Silver Glen Springs without guides or limits. Jet Skis can reach speeds up to 55 MPH and accommodate up to three riders with a combined weight limit of 530 lbs. Pontoon boats accommodate up to 11 passengers for cruising, swimming, and wildlife spotting.
extraNote: Arrive at least 30 minutes prior to rental time for safety briefing and paperwork · Based at Renegades on the River · Year-round
